newsitem.title: UK: UK housing starts up s/a 3.0 pct in 3 mths to Jan.
newsitem.headline: UK housing starts up s/a 3.0 pct in 3 mths to Jan.

text.p: UK housing starts rose a seasonally adjusted 3.0 percent in the three months to January from the previous three months while total completions were up 1.0 percent, the Department of the Environment said.
In the three months November to January, 41,800 dwellings were started, up 27 per cent on the same three months a year ago, while completions at 45,500 were down five per cent.
Private enterprise starts were up four percent while completions were up by three percent, the DoE said.
Housing Association starts of new dwellings in the three months November 1996 to January 1997 were a little higher compared with the previous three months, but completions fell back.
Both starts and completions by local authorities and government departments remained at a low level.
